pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu gǎnshàng nánmén de chē , zǎokè sàn shí , tā zhàn zài láng xià xiǎng le yíhuìer , háishì xiān bǎ shǒulǐ de liáng chǐ huán jìn guì .
pairs.english: Tavi missed the carts at the south gate; when morning class ended, he stood thinking in the corridor a while, but still first returned the measuring rule in his hand to the cupboard.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有赶上南门的车，早课散时，他站在廊下想了一会儿，还是先把手里的量尺还进柜。

pairs.target: nài lěi wǔhòu lái guò , liúhuà shuō liǎngliàngchē dōu zǒu le , táng ruì xián yǒurén bǎ tā de dùn dāng xíngli guàgōu , chū ménqián yòu jiào rén xièxià yìzhī lánzi .
pairs.english: Nerai had come that afternoon, leaving word that both carts had departed; Tang Rui objected to someone treating her shield as a luggage hook and then made them remove a basket before leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾午后来过，留话说两辆车都走了，唐芮嫌有人把她的盾当行李挂钩，出门前又叫人卸下一只篮子。

pairs.target: tīngjiàn zhè jù , tǎ wéi xiào le yíxià , dào le cìrì liànxí shí , què réng bǎ zuórì méi qù chéng de nà diǎn jí dài jìn wūlǐ .
pairs.english: Hearing this, Tavi laughed once; yet when the next day's practice came, he still brought into the room that small bit of impatience from having missed the outing yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 听见这句，塔维笑了一下，到了次日练习时，却仍把昨日没去成的那点急带进屋里。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn kàn tā jiāng kōng mù tuō yíxià ná qǐ , méi shēnshǒu jiē , xiān ràng tā fàng huíqù , bǎ xiùkǒu juǎn hǎo , zuǒjiǎo de wèizhì yě zìjǐ chóngxīn zhǎo .
pairs.english: Song Yuan saw him snatch up the empty wooden carriers, but did not reach to meet them; he first had him put them back, roll up his cuffs and find the position of the left foot again himself too.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远看他将空木托一下拿起，没伸手接，先让他放回去，把袖口卷好，左脚的位置也自己重新找。

pairs.target: gāo dèng réng zài shēnhòu , zuǒ xī zǒu píngdì bù téng , shēn wān què qiān , tā zuòxià tiáo guò dèng gāo , zài qǐshēn zhànwěn , méiyǒu ná jīnrì néng zhàn biàn dàngchéng néng pǎo .
pairs.english: The high stool was still behind him; his left knee did not hurt on level walks, but pulled in a deep bend; he sat to adjust the stool height, then rose and stood securely, without treating being able to stand today as being able to run.
pairs.hanzi: 高凳仍在身后，左膝走平地不疼，深弯却牵，他坐下调过凳高，再起身站稳，没有拿今日能站便当成能跑。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī hái méi kāi guì , xiān kàn tā nà zhāng huà , dèngzi páng de yì shuāngjiǎo huà de dà , liǎngzhī mù tuō dào jǐ zài zhǐbiān , xiàng pà zhàn le biérén de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey had not opened the cupboard yet, first looking at that drawing of his; the pair of feet beside the stool was drawn large, while the two wooden carriers crowded the paper's edge, as if afraid of taking someone else's space.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师还没开柜，先看他那张画，凳子旁的一双脚画得大，两只木托倒挤在纸边，像怕占了别人的地方。

pairs.target: tā wèn zhè liǎngchù rújīn shì shuí ná , tǎ wéi shuō dōu shì zìjǐ , jiǎngwán cái bǎ zhǐ zhuǎnzhèng , jiāng zìjǐ zuǒ zhǒu yào liú de kòng chù bǔ chūlái .
pairs.english: She asked who was holding these two places now; Tavi said both were his, and only after speaking turned the paper straight and filled in the space his own left elbow needed.
pairs.hanzi: 她问这两处如今是谁拿，塔维说都是自己，讲完才把纸转正，将自己左肘要留的空处补出来。

pairs.target: jīnrì xiān búyòng rén cóng shēnhòu guò , sòng yuǎn zhàn dào yòuqiánfāng , zhàojiù cóng yòubiān mànmàn tiē zhǎng , tǎ wéi zhǐ ná kōng tuō , xiān shì liǎngshǒu zěnyàng fàng cái bú hùxiāng zhē .
pairs.english: Today no one would pass by behind him at first; Song Yuan stood forward on the right and slowly brought his palm against him from the right as before; Tavi held only empty carriers, first trying how to place both hands so they did not hide each other.
pairs.hanzi: 今日先不用人从身后过，宋远站到右前方，照旧从右边慢慢贴掌，塔维只拿空托，先试两手怎样放才不互相遮。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yòubiān táigāo yìdiǎn , kànqīng le mù biān , zuǒ zhǒu què gēnzhe wǎng lǐ shōu , zuǒ tuō de jìhào yòu bèi yòushǒu dǎng qù bànjié .
pairs.english: He raised the right side a little and saw the wooden edge clearly, but his left elbow followed and drew inward, and the marker on the left carrier was again hidden halfway by his right hand.
pairs.hanzi: 他将右边抬高一点，看清了木边，左肘却跟着往里收，左托的记号又被右手挡去半截。

pairs.target: zhèhuí tā méiyǒu dīng dào yǎnjīng fāsuān , xiān jiào sòng yuǎn tíng , tuìhuí yuánchù , huàn le zuǒ zhǒu de wèizhì , jiào tā zài mànmànlái .
pairs.english: This time he did not stare until his eyes ached; he first asked Song Yuan to stop, went back to the starting position, changed the place of his left elbow, and asked him to come slowly again.
pairs.hanzi: 这回他没有盯到眼睛发酸，先叫宋远停，退回原处，换了左肘的位置，叫他再慢慢来。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí liǎngchù dōu kàndejiàn , sòng yuǎn de shǒu réng zhǐ qīng tiēzhe , méiyǒu jiālì , wéi lǎoshī jiào tā jìzhù de shì zhège wèizhì , búshì jīnrì zhōngyú búpà le .
pairs.english: On the second attempt both places were visible; Song Yuan kept his hand touching lightly only, without adding force; Teacher Vey told him that the thing to remember was this position, rather than think today meant he was finally unafraid.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回两处都看得见，宋远的手仍只轻贴着，没有加力，维老师叫他记住的是这个位置，不是今日终于不怕了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , zuòxià hēshuǐ , bēi lǐ méiyǒu fàng chá , tā hēwán cái fāxiàn , fāngcái zìjǐ jìng xiǎngzhe hē yìkǒu biàn néng gǎnshàng xià yíjiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded and sat to drink water; there was no tea in the cup, and only after finishing did he realise that just now he had actually been thinking that drinking a mouthful would let him catch up with the next thing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，坐下喝水，杯里没有放茶，他喝完才发现，方才自己竟想着喝一口便能赶上下一件。

pairs.target: xiē guòhòu , tā mō guò bēi yán , zhǐjiān dōu qīngchǔ , wéi lǎoshī cái qǔchū yuánlái nà liǎngpiàn tiě , qīngzài , dǎng piàn , bù diàn hé duǎnshéng yīyī chá guò .
pairs.english: After resting, he felt the cup rim, every fingertip clear; only then did Teacher Vey take out those two original iron pieces, checking the light loads, stops, cloth padding and short cords one by one.
pairs.hanzi: 歇过后，他摸过杯沿，指尖都清楚，维老师才取出原来那两片铁，轻载、挡片、布垫和短绳一一查过。

pairs.target: liǎngbiān pǔtōng shòulì rènqīng , mù tuō jiē huí zhǎng lǐ , réng zhǐ lí diàn yìdiǎn , jiǎo bù nuó , sòng yuǎn děng tā táitóu cái jiāng yòuzhǎng mànmàn tiē shàng .
pairs.english: With ordinary loading clear on both sides, the wooden carriers came back into his palms, still only a little above the padding, feet fixed; Song Yuan waited for him to look up before slowly bringing his right palm into contact.
pairs.hanzi: 两边普通受力认清，木托接回掌里，仍只离垫一点，脚不挪，宋远等他抬头才将右掌慢慢贴上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi rèn zhù liǎngbiān , qīngqīng jiē qǐ nà yìdiǎn chābié , zuǒbiān duō tuìràng , yòubiān shǎo xiē , yǎnqián de jìhào méiyǒu yīn xiǎng dǎngzhù sòng yuǎn biàn yìqí wǎng lǐ pǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi held both sides in mind and gently linked that small difference, more yielding on the left and less on the right; the markers before him did not all rush inward simply because he wanted to block Song Yuan.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维认住两边，轻轻接起那一点差别，左边多退让，右边少些，眼前的记号没有因想挡住宋远便一齐往里跑。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī kànguò , shuō shōu , tǎ wéi liǎng zhǎng réng tiēzhe , xiān jiāng liǎngbiān tuìhuí pǔtōng , sòng yuǎn děng tā chá hǎo cái chè zhǎng , méiyǒu ràng nà diǎn biànhuà gēn zheshǒu zhuī chūqù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey checked and said to cancel; Tavi kept both palms in contact, first returning both sides to normal; Song Yuan waited for her check before withdrawing his palm, without letting that small change chase after his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师看过，说收，塔维两掌仍贴着，先将两边退回普通，宋远等她查好才撤掌，没有让那点变化跟着手追出去。

pairs.target: tiě fàng huí diàn shàng , zài chá , xièzài , lí shǒu , tā zuòxià shí zhǐ juéde yǎnlǐ yǒuxiē lèi , zhǐjiān què réng rènde chū cèzi biān nà dào pòkǒu .
pairs.english: The iron went back onto the padding for rechecking, unloading and release; when he sat, he only felt a little tired in his eyes, but his fingertips could still recognise the tear at the notebook's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 铁放回垫上，再查、卸载、离手，他坐下时只觉得眼里有些累，指尖却仍认得出册子边那道破口。

pairs.target: tā wèn zìjǐ ruò xiān chè yìzhī shǒu ne , sòng yuǎn shuō jīnrì méi zuò nà jiàn , bié ná zhè huíshōu de hǎo tì xià yìhuí dāying , wéi lǎoshī yě méi chóngxīn shàngzài .
pairs.english: He asked what if he withdrew one hand first; Song Yuan said they had not done that today, and should not use this good cancellation to promise for the next attempt; Teacher Vey did not reload either.
pairs.hanzi: 他问自己若先撤一只手呢，宋远说今日没做那件，别拿这回收得好替下一回答应，维老师也没重新上载。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe kōngxiàlái de mù tuō , shuō táng ruì nádào mùbǐng shàng hái liú zhe yìdiǎn , zìjǐ xué gōnglǐ yě búshì cóngméi shì guò lí shǒu , wèishénme zhèlǐ yòu zǒng cóngtóulái .
pairs.english: Tavi watched the emptied wooden carriers, saying Tang Rui still retained a little when she took the wooden grips; it was not as though he himself had never tried lifting his hands at the academy either, so why always start over here again?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着空下来的木托，说唐芮拿到木柄上还留着一点，自己学宫里也不是从没试过离手，为什么这里又总从头来。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī cóng guì lǐ qǔchū tā zǎonián liàn guò de zhuōshàng jiājù , tóng yǎnqián mù tuō bǎi chéng liǎngliè , zhǐ wèn dāngshí dōngxī zài nǎér , tǎ wéi shuō zài zhuōshàng , zìjǐ kěyǐ bǎ liǎngshǒu dōu shēnhuíqù .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey took the bench fixture he had practised with long ago from the cupboard and set it in two rows with the wooden carriers before him; she only asked where the objects had been then; Tavi said on the table, where he could reach both hands back together.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师从柜里取出他早年练过的桌上夹具，同眼前木托摆成两列，只问当时东西在哪儿，塔维说在桌上，自己可以把两手都伸回去。

pairs.target: zhèhuí yìbiān ruò hù zhe xiōngkǒu , lìngyìbiān liúzài héchù , shǒu méi néng tóngshí huílái shí shuí tì tā shōu , tā shuō dào zhèlǐ , méi zài bǎ liǎngliè huàchéng yíliè .
pairs.english: If one side guarded his chest this time, where would the other remain, and who would cancel for him when his hands could not return together; at this point he stopped speaking, without combining the two rows into one again.
pairs.hanzi: 这回一边若护着胸口，另一边留在何处，手没能同时回来时谁替他收，他说到这里，没再把两列划成一列。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu bǎ mù tuōshōu zǒu , jiào tā gǎirì xiān ná kōng de bǐyibǐ , jīnrì dào cǐ , shǒushàng méi fā dùn yě búbì bǎ yǎnjīng de lèi lìngjì dào biéchù .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not take the wooden carriers away, telling him to use empty ones first for comparison another day; today they were done, and clear fingers did not mean he should record the tiredness in his eyes in another place.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没有把木托收走，叫他改日先拿空的比一比，今日到此，手上没发钝也不必把眼睛的累另记到别处。

pairs.target: ménwài yǒurén qiāo le liǎngxià , sòng yuǎn yìngshēng chūqù jiē huán lái de hùjù , tǎ wéi bǎ zhǐ wǎng pángbiān ràng , méi zài zhuī zhe wèn shénme shíhòu cáinéng duō liú yíhuìer .
pairs.english: Someone knocked twice outside; Song Yuan answered and went out to receive the returned protective gear; Tavi moved his paper aside, no longer pursuing when he could retain it a little longer.
pairs.hanzi: 门外有人敲了两下，宋远应声出去接还来的护具，塔维把纸往旁边让，没再追着问什么时候才能多留一会儿。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn nà zhāng tú , zuǒbiān de mù tuō hái méi huà jìnqù , zhǐ shàng dào xiān yǒu le zìjǐ wòbǐ shí cèng chū de yídào mò .
pairs.english: He looked down at that drawing; the left wooden carrier had not been drawn in yet, but the paper already bore a streak of ink rubbed there while he held his pen.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头看那张图，左边的木托还没画进去，纸上倒先有了自己握笔时蹭出的一道墨。

pairs.target: tā ná bù cā , yuè cā yuè kuān , sòng yuǎn huílái jiàn le , wèn zhè shìbushì yě yào suàn yìtiáo lù , tǎ wéi shuō búshì , shì hé , chē bùnéng zǒu .
pairs.english: He wiped it with a cloth, making it wider and wider; Song Yuan returned, saw it and asked whether this counted as a road too; Tavi said no, it was a river, and carts could not go there.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿布擦，越擦越宽，宋远回来见了，问这是不是也要算一条路，塔维说不是，是河，车不能走。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiāng bù jiēguò qù , méi tīngdǒng qián xiē rìzi nàpánqí , tǎ wéi zìjǐ xiào le hǎo yízhèn , xiào wán cái ná qǐ lìng yìzhāng zhǐ .
pairs.english: Song Yuan took the cloth without understanding that game from some days ago; Tavi laughed to himself for quite a while, and only when he had finished did he pick up another sheet of paper.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远将布接过去，没听懂前些日子那盘棋，塔维自己笑了好一阵，笑完才拿起另一张纸。
